preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to configure burn settings or call manual burn
LP burn must be enabled (lpBurnEnabled = true)
Sufficient time must pass since last burn (block.timestamp >= lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency for auto, or block.timestamp > lastManualLpBurnTime + manualBurnFrequency for manual)
UniswapV2 pair must hold MARVIN token balance to burn

logic_check.expected_value: LP pair MARVIN token balance decreased after burn execution

exploit_hint: As owner, call setAutoLPBurnSettings to configure burn frequency (minimum 600 seconds) and burn percentage (maximum 1000 = 10%). Wait for lpBurnFrequency to elapse, then trigger any transfer to the automatedMarketMakerPairs[to] to execute autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens() automatically. Alternatively, call manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens(uint256 percent) directly with up to 10% burn after 30 minute cooldown. This burns MARVIN tokens from the liquidity pool to 0xdead address, reducing pool liquidity and manipulating token economics without liquidity provider consent.
